templates.text: Sharp scent of alcohol → full-body startle, followed by a sharp, high-pitched cry.
Sudden whiff of formula → immediate rooting, hands grasping toward source.
Overpowering floral perfume → head jerks away, face scrunches, cry erupts.
Acrid smoke odor → apnea for {seconds} seconds, then frantic limb flailing.
Mother's milk scent → head turns vigorously, mouth opens wide, sucking motions begin.
Pungent antiseptic → eyes squeeze shut, torso arches, a short, sharp wail.
Strong mint aroma → sneeze reflex triggers, arms fling out in Moro-like response.
Sour milk smell → grimace, tongue protrusion, turning head to avoid stimulus.
Faint vanilla → brief quieting, then active sniffing and mouthing movements.
Rancid odor → gag reflex initiates, face reddens, cry is strained and guttural.
Sharp ammonia → legs draw up to abdomen, cry is sudden and loud.
Lavender essence → initial stillness, then deep sigh and relaxed limb extension.
Burnt toast scent → coughing fit, eyes water, arms wave in distress.
Sweet fruit aroma → lips smack, tongue explores, hands move to mouth.
Intense body odor → head aversion, increased respiratory rate, fretful cry.
Saline solution smell → brow furrows, brief whimper, then vigorous head shake.
Strong coffee → whole-body jolt, eyes open wide, a single sharp vocalization.
Familiar caregiver scent → rooting intensifies, body stills, cry ceases abruptly.
Chemical cleaner → sneezing sequence, followed by a prolonged, unhappy cry.
Spicy food aroma → sneeze, then facial flushing and increased salivation.
Stale air odor → fussy squirming, irregular breathing pattern, low-grade cry.
Fresh bread smell → alert orienting, mouth opens, hands make grasping motions.
Metallic blood scent → gasp, then full Moro reflex with loud cry.
Overripe fruit → gagging, nose wrinkling, turning head side to side.
Eucalyptus → deep inhalation, brief arousal, then a shudder and sigh.
Sour citrus → eyes blink rapidly, tongue thrusts out, cry is short and sharp.
Musty odor → sneeze, then general increased motor activity and fussing.
Warm milk vapor → immediate sucking motions, hands clench, body curls forward.
Sharp vinegar → apnea, then explosive cry with coordinated limb extension.
Unfamiliar cologne → startle, followed by scanning head movements and wary quiet.
